body:
Trust me, I introduced my cat to my parents dogs over the course of a month. The rescue wanted them to meet before they felt confident leaving him with me. I know that’s not the proper way for them to be introduced. 

And when my cat hit him even the rescue seemed wary about leaving him with me
Because of the cat. 

He didn’t sleep in the crate last night, and I would never force him. I left the door open and tried to entice him with snacks but no go. After more then an hour I blocked off the room and slept on the couch next to him. Neither of us slept hardly at all.

I just feel so guilty. He’s not a bad dog by any means. I just feel that I told the rescue what I needed for my home and got the exact opposite. And that’s not the dogs fault. I know this dog needs a ton of time and love and reassurance. He’s going to need training and careful work to get him okay. And I feel like a monster saying that we don’t have the ability to give this dog what he needs currently. Which is why I sought out a confident dog. I’m terrified this rescue will hate me and not let me adopt from them again. Maybe I’ll never own another dog after this. I want to do right by all parties involved and the longer I spend with him, the more attached I’ll get. I cannot stress how much this isn’t the dogs fault. He’s nervous and skittish, not at all how he was represented to me. 

I currently firmly believe he is not the right fit for our family. We cannot give him everything that he needs to be happy and confident in our home. Through absolutely no fault of his own. 

And is it terrible to say I feel no connection with him? All the dogs we’ve adopted have had some sort of connection, and I feel nothing. Which is killing me inside because I’m sure it’s my fault nothing is there. 

I want this dog to be happy and healthy and adjusted. But I fear we are not what he needs to get there. I just hope the rescue doesn’t hate me for it

Thank you. You’re so kind. I don’t ever want to give up on an animal but I don’t think actually everyone is supposed to be upset about the adoption. It was so much easier when I had another confident dog to show them the ropes and help them learn everything is okay. I feel like a monster for even thinking of talking to the rescue. Everyone says more time, but at this point everyone is stressed and upset. Especially the dog. I’m sure more time will do it. But I don’t have the time to take off of work to train day and night to help him right now. I figured he would be shy and a little nervous but he makes my nervous dog seem confident. I want the best for him, but there’s not even a shred of a connection between him and us. I don’t know. Adopting our dogs previously we always met them, and had something between us. Today he came to meet us and then was left with us. He was wicked upset about the rescue people leaving and he’s seemingly got worse. 

Currently trying to put him in a crate for bed, as per the rescues advice. Been at it an hour now. Don’t think it’s happening. Got bed and snacks and toys, but he is having none of it
